sentences.text: From the seven thirty fix, lay a new course line to the mark.
Then draw a current diagram, with the current setting one six zero at one point six knots, to find the course to steer that keeps you on that line, and your speed made good along it.
Convert the course to steer to a compass course, using the variation and the deviation for the new heading.
Finally, measure the remaining distance and divide by the speed made good, not your boat speed, to get the new ETA.
